constraints: This is a non-batch, zero-experiment pre-admission search task. Do not create B71, BATCH, IDEA, EV, DEC, CORR, experiment, implementation, status transition, speedup, attack, SOTA, or breakthrough records or claims. Do not open any family pre-admission intake from the current archive.

Rounds seven through thirteen's searched scopes are frozen and disjoint from this round (subresultant/modular-composition/fast-remainder/Semaev/unranking/transposed-evaluation; full-text/function-field/transfer-theoretic; structured/sparse/triangular/black-box resultant; normal-form/regular-chain and mixed-radix; coding theory/sparse interpolation; eigenvalue/structured-matrix methods; algebraic complexity theory/interactive-proof methods) and must not be re-run.

Scope: bounded network retrieval (webfetch against the arXiv export API) over numerical algebraic geometry -- witness-set representations of algebraic varieties, monodromy-based numerical irreducible decomposition, polynomial homotopy continuation (parameter homotopy, coefficient-parameter continuation), and numerical elimination via random linear slicing (numerically computing a resultant-like object by tracking solutions of a sliced system rather than symbolically expanding a resultant). For every candidate, identify explicitly what serves as the 'start system' or 'seed' the continuation method requires, and whether that seed is genuinely public and computable from E, P, Q alone within budget, or whether it silently requires knowing g_I's roots or an equivalent witness first (in which case it fails G2/G8 the same way every prior round's already-given-system candidates did).

A candidate built from numerical/continuation machinery must explain why the specific complete-chart instance is not the already-costed norm/resultant/quotient route it generalizes numerically; if it cannot, G8 is absent and say so. Name the specific ROUTE-01 through ROUTE-08 route (per experiments/EXP-CREP-001/specification.yaml) any candidate would reduce to, following round twelve and thirteen's precedent of naming the specific route.

Numerical methods carry an additional honesty requirement this round's mechanism card must address explicitly: floating-point or fixed-precision numerical computation of an object whose EXACT value is required (a public transducer for r_R mod g_I in a finite field, not an approximation) may not silently substitute approximate equality for exact equality. If a candidate relies on numerical path-tracking, state explicitly how (or whether) it recovers an exact finite-field answer, and at what precision/certification cost -- an uncertified numerical answer is not a typed trigger.

The six terminal pre-admission packets named in read_scope are screened families. Do not re-run their frozen screens. A screened family may be revisited only through a new trigger specific to that family satisfying its post-screen revisit conditions.

Every candidate considered is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8 itemization as in prior rounds' mechanism cards, using the amended G2/G8 wording at preadmission_gate_g2_g8_wording_amendment_20260830). A candidate is intake-ready only if every item is present; record exactly which items are absent for every near-miss.
No commands, programs, experiments, benchmarks, computer algebra, or implementation. The one maximum run is the bounded inference session only; experiment_maximum_runs is zero.

Controls before belief: for any candidate that appears to pass, verify the computation is genuinely public (no ECDLP-equivalent information hidden behind the continuation's start system, path parameters, or certification step), re-check the quantifier order, and run the already-costed-route exclusion as a named check.
Pareto honesty is mandatory: until a typed trigger with a complete gate discharge exists, obtained_delta is none, sota_delta is unknown, Pollard rho remains the realized frontier.
Citation provenance is mandatory. Every source carries recalled | retrieved | kb | internal.

Write the three substantive artifacts first and runtime-session-receipt.json last. YAML hygiene is mandatory and will be independently re-checked with a strict parser: no plain scalar may contain an embedded, unescaped double-quote or a colon-followed-by-space -- wrap the ENTIRE scalar in single quotes if either is needed. No duplicated top-level keys at any nesting level, no bare mapping key inside a block sequence without a leading '-'. This defect class has broken artifacts in four of the last nine rounds; check every free-text field and every list line by line before finishing.
